Only with the dash connected. Send puts the name of a street in Devanagari, as UTF-8, in the dash\'s title and street (the field holds 19 bytes, so only the first word fits); Stop gives the real street back.
Sending the Devanagari street. Look at the dash, then press Stop.

Makes the app read another brand, to see the \"Keep REau running\" card and page as a Xiaomi or realme rider would. The phone must have joined the dash once. The log says when a brand is faked. A restart of the app gives the real brand back.

Forgets the answer to the notice, so the card comes back on the main screen (it needs a Xiaomi or realme brand, faked or real). On a Motorola faked as Xiaomi, the Autostart button fails on the maker\'s two screens and falls to the app\'s details: that is the chain working, and the log says so.
